insights.headline: Silver slides to fresh 11-month low near $51 as Fed-hike bets deepen; SGB 2019-20 holders exit at ₹14,213
insights.summary: Silver extended its slide to a fresh low since November, touching near $51 an ounce as strong US GDP and inflation data kept December Fed-hike odds near 90%. Gold held near $4,025 as markets weighed the Fed's 10-2 vote to hold rates against sticky inflation. In India, RBI fixed the SGB 2019-20 Series VI premature redemption at ₹14,213 per unit — nearly 3.7x its 2019 issue price — while MCX gold futures steadied around ₹1.43 lakh per 10 grams.
points: Silver fell to a fresh low since November near $51.00, down ~1.25% on the day, with oversold RSI at 27.21 and $50 the next downside target.
Q3 US GDP beat estimates at 3.4% and September PCE inflation rose 0.5% to 3.6% YoY, cementing bets on a December Fed hike.
RBI set SGB 2019-20 Series VI's premature redemption at ₹14,213/unit, ~3.7x the ₹3,835 issue price; the request window already closed.
MCX December gold futures steadied at ₹1,43,807 per 10 grams on firm spot demand, reversing part of Wednesday's slide.
Silver's ~55% plunge from January's peak has failed to spark Indian festive buying, with dealers reporting subdued stocking.

trending.title: Silver's plunge deepens into Dhanteras season
trending.summary: Silver touched a fresh 11-month low near $51, extending a ~55% collapse from January's peak — yet Indian festive buyers are staying away, with dealers calling stocking subdued.

trending.title: Fed-hike bets cap both metals
trending.summary: Hot US GDP and PCE data have December rate-hike odds near 90%, pinning gold near $4,025 and stripping silver of any safe-haven bid.

trending.title: SGB holders cash in near-record prices
trending.summary: The RBI's ₹14,213 redemption price for the 2019-20 Series VI tranche turns a ₹3,835-per-gram 2019 investment into nearly 3.7x — plus 2.5% annual interest.

trending.title: Festive gold stays pricey for buyers
trending.summary: Indian buyers are getting Fed-driven breathing room, but MCX gold near ₹1.43 lakh keeps Dhanteras shopping expensive, with jewellers dangling discounts.

items.title: Silver's 55% plunge fails to spark festive buying
items.summary: Mint reports that silver's roughly 55% plunge from its January peak — over $121 an ounce and ₹4.2 lakh a kg then, about $52 and under ₹2 lakh now — has failed to spark festive-season buying in India, with investors sitting on losses and dealers describing festive stocking as subdued.

items.title: Silver Forecast: XAG/USD hits fresh YTD low near $51.00
items.summary: Silver extended its downtrend for a third straight day, hitting a fresh low since November 2025 near $51.00 in Friday's Asian session before recovering to about $51.50-51.55, FXStreet reports. With the RSI at 27.21 in oversold territory, it sees rallies above $52 facing fresh sellers and warns a break below $51.00 would expose the $50 psychological mark. XAG/USD is down roughly 1.25% on the day.

items.title: Gold prices edge lower as US inflation data reinforces Fed outlook
items.summary: Gold edged lower after September US inflation data reinforced bets on further Fed tightening, ET reports. The Fed's preferred PCE gauge rose 0.5% on the month — its biggest gain in six months — lifting annual inflation to 3.6%, while Q3 GDP beat estimates at 3.4%. Spot gold slipped about 1% to near $4,025 on Thursday as December rate-hike odds held near 85%.

items.title: Gold Prices Slip as Fed Rate Outlook Shifts; Silver Hits 11-Month Low
items.summary: Spot gold fell 0.4% to $4,024 an ounce on Thursday as strong US growth and inflation data reinforced bets on a December Fed hike; silver dropped 2.6% to $52.39, its lowest since late November last year, widening the gold-silver ratio to about 77. CME FedWatch priced December hike odds at 83.3% after the data.

items.title: Sovereign Gold Bond premature redemption today: ₹3,835 investment turns into ₹14,213; check SGB 2019-20 Series VI investors' gains
items.summary: RBI has fixed the premature redemption price of SGB 2019-20 Series VI at ₹14,213 per unit for October 30, 2026 — about 3.7 times its ₹3,835-per-gram issue price of October 2019, Upstox reports. The price is the simple average of IBJA's 999-purity gold closes on October 27-29; the request window (Sep 29–Oct 21) has closed. SGBs pay 2.5% annual interest, semi-annually.

items.title: Indian gold buyers get a 'breathing room' from Fed before Diwali, but conditions apply
items.summary: The Fed's hold at 3.75-4.00% may keep gold range-bound in the coming weeks, giving Indian buyers breathing room ahead of Diwali, ET reports, as domestic discounts narrow to about $2 an ounce on picking festive demand. But a sustained recovery hinges on December-hike expectations easing from ~78% odds; US inflation data, yields, the dollar/rupee rate and Middle East risk could keep prices volatile.

items.title: Silver: Industrial Resilience Meets a Restrictive Monetary Backdrop
items.summary: FXEmpire frames silver between modestly resilient US industrial demand — September industrial production rose 0.7% — and a restrictive monetary backdrop after the Fed held at 3.75–4% with two dissents for a hike. With 10-year real yields at 2.67% and silver futures near $52.52 below $55 support, it flags $50 as the next potential downside target.

items.title: Domestic gold futures rise to ₹1.43 lakh/10 gm on firm spot demand
items.summary: Gold futures for December delivery rose ₹102, or 0.07%, to ₹1,43,807 per 10 grams on MCX in a turnover of 811 lots as speculators built fresh positions on firm spot demand, reversing part of Wednesday's ₹646 slide. Globally, gold futures fell 0.58% to $4,043.77 an ounce in New York (PTI via BusinessLine).

items.title: Gold (XAU/USD) Price Forecast: Bearish Reversal Threatens Key Support
items.summary: FXEmpire's technical outlook says gold printed a one-day bearish reversal on Thursday, falling to a two-day low near $4,005 as sellers defended resistance around $4,069. A decisive break below the recent $3,975 low would put the June $3,942 swing low at risk, while October's test of the 20-month moving average — the first since October 2023 — marks critical monthly support.

items.title: UBS sees limited gold downside as three demand pillars set a floor near $4,000
items.summary: UBS sees limited downside for gold from around $4,000 an ounce, arguing that strong central-bank buying, robust Chinese demand and worries over public debt should put a floor under prices even after gold ETFs saw net outflows last week.

items.title: SAT sets aside ₹1.49 crore MCX penalty on Ventura over invalid order
items.summary: The Securities Appellate Tribunal set aside a ₹1.49 crore penalty that MCX had imposed on Ventura, ruling the order invalid, Business Standard reported. The decision removes a regulatory overhang for the broker in India's commodity derivatives market.

items.title: KISNA offers 105% old-gold exchange value and 100% off making charges for Dhanteras and Diwali
items.summary: KISNA Diamond & Gold Jewellery is wooing festive buyers for Dhanteras and Diwali: 105% exchange value on old gold towards diamond jewellery, up to 100% off making charges on select jewellery, and double gold rate protection with 25% down payment. Its 'Shop Sparkle Win '26' draw across 218 cities offers 823 vehicles — 247 cars and 576 scooters — with the final draw in early December 2026.
